text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out, Agnes Digital and I
head to the
photo book release event.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King and her entourage are so amazing!
They
really know how to land a joke!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I would've been perfectly happy just
seeing the
three of them perform live,
but we're being
blessed with a talk
session too?! I gotta send a
letter of
thanks to the organizer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hi, Digital. Do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwah! K-King?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have something I'd like to ask you.
Would you
mind coming over here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: For reeeeal?! You want me to stand in?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that a member of King Halo's

entourage isn't feeling too well, so she's
asked
Agnes Digital to sub in.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's no way that... that I can take
on such a
big role...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But surely you know all the songs, given
that
you're always showing up to support
my
performances.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-but... I'm not prepared. What happens
if I get
up there and soil your glorious
event?!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I get what she's saying, King. It is a big ask to spring on someone out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Then, does that mean... we're
going to
have to cancel?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...Twitch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No...
choice_data_list: Are you really going to leave your fave hanging when she needs help?
Are you really going to leave your fave hanging when she needs help?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No! Of course not!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King! If you're really okay with me,
then... please,
let me sub in!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wonderful!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Remember, the stage up there is mine!
All you
need to do is enjoy yourself as
much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the mini concert begins with
Agnes
Digital performing in perfect sync
with King Halo
and her entourage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The audience is enjoying the
performance.
Midway through, the music
changes to an
instrumental section, and I
catch Agnes Digital's
eye. She looks as if
she wants me to do
something...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You're so kind to cheer for me! I wasn't
even
supposed to be up here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...But you don't have to worry about me.
A
concert is where you show your love to
your
faves. Surely, your cheers should be
aimed
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So don't hold back, everyone! Give a big
shout
and pack it full of all your love!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ready... GO!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: KING HALOOO!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Very well, I shall grace you
with a reply
just as good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that, King Halo puts on a
performance
that gets the audience
even more hyped!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good job getting the crowd going,
Digital. I truly
appreciate it, really. I'll
give you a proper thanks
on a later date.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Pheeeeew... I'm so glad the mini concert
went
well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've been practicing my crowd work for a
while
since I figured one day I might
have a chance to
do a winning concert.
choice_data_list: You were great at hyping up the crowd!
You were great at hyping up the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm on the stage, I want to
make my
Umas shine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And don't think I didn't notice you
cheering like a
pro out there. With you
in the audience, I
probably have nothing
to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With you in the crowd and me on stage,
we can
hype up Umamusume together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King! We can't wait any longer! Let's
give them
what they want!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Well, if you insist! What's my
naaame?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's more resonant than anything
else?

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: King's beautiful and resplendent voice!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Tell me about this stage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's blindingly brilliant! King is more
suited to the
spotlight than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm the definitive first-rate

Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! We're just getting started!
Submit
yourselves to my intoxicating
charm!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You were the perfect substitute, Digital.
I truly
appreciate your help, really. I'll
give you a proper
thanks on a later date.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Swoon... I got a compliment from King... From now on, I'm recognizing today as King Halo Day!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Don't think I didn't notice you during
the King
Commendation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, all of the fans came here
anticipating an
experience only King and
her entourage could
provide!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And... now I know I can trust you to lead
the
cheers from the stands at my own
winning
concerts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With you in the crowd and me on stage,
we can
hype up Umamusume together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn on the light sticks that Agnes
Digital left
with me and hold them up in
both hands.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, what a beautiful sea of light!
Okay,
everyone, let's paint the audience
in the color of
King!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the lights in the crowd change
immediately,
reflecting King Halo's
colors.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wow, isn't that beautiful! Everyone's

consideration is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In which case, I'll have to respond in
kind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that, King Halo caters to her
fans
making them even more hyped!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good job getting the crowd going,
Digital. I truly
appreciate it, really. I'll
give you a proper thanks
on a later date.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wheeew... It looks like we were able to
preserve
King's honor.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I should be saying that to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I could see from the stage the emotion
you put
into waving your light sticks!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I felt your desire to show your oshi the
most
spectacular view!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And... now I know I can trust you to lead
the
cheers from the stands at my own
winning
concerts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With you in the crowd and me on stage,
we can
hype up Umamusume together!
